note: Session B4: how the live model reads where to deliver. From the founder's first live order on 13 Nov 2026 (wa_messages and agent_runs on staging, 18:43-18:58 UTC): the village glued to «ع» went to needs_clarification, and «بحي راجح» in a voice note was read as a village. village: the village the reading must put in address.village (any spelling of it), or null when it must stay empty. not_village: words that must never be address.village. The code no longer depends on the first (village_in_text, the pin decides) or the second (a pin's address step ignores the village): these cases watch the model itself.
